My first experience at a beauty clinic was because I saw my seniors getting great results, so I followed suit, wanting clear, radiant skin.

My first visit was very impressive. Both the reception staff and the doctor were very welcoming. They discussed my skin condition and offered many recommendations, leading me to consider additional treatments instead of just minor ones. The after-sales service was excellent; the admin team contacted me to check on my condition and provided skincare advice. It was a great experience!

On my second visit, of course, after finding a clinic I liked, I wanted to go back.

However, that turned out to be my last decision to go to a beauty clinic. During my second visit, I had an appointment several weeks in advance, but I had to wait a very long time (almost 3 hours) because the clinic was experiencing some kind of problem that I didn't quite understand. The doctor explained that they were adjusting the needle technique and dosage because some clients were allergic, causing dullness. It turned out that these adjustments caused my own skin problems; I developed noticeable dark spots instead of the usual ones. Furthermore, the doctor's touch during the mesotherapy injection wasn't gentle enough, resulting in noticeable bruising.

Currently, I'm unsure about the clinic's status or how they've addressed the issues. But our decision not to go back is a very serious one, a decision we've learned our lesson from.
